sources.snippet: This is a face parsing model for high-precision facial feature segmentation based on BiSeNet: Bilateral Segmentation Network for Real-time Semantic Segmentation. This model accurately segments various facial components such as the eyes, nose, mouth, and the contour of the face from images. This repo provides a different training & inference code and new backbone model has been added.
